zh.summary: 以低保真四狀態草圖說明操作、條件與回饋，再用走讀修正設計，最後才細化視覺。
objectives: 用線框稿表示畫面內容、主要動作及狀態轉換。
從現有四狀態 SVG 建立可修改的 wireframe.svg 與文字註記。
說明靜態草圖能驗證的問題與尚不能證明的行為。

readingGuide.goal: 用線框稿表示畫面內容、主要動作及狀態轉換。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: 可在瀏覽器開啟的四狀態 wireframe.svg，以及能重演缺件與修改路徑的 wireframe-notes.md。

sections.heading: 線框稿要讓人說出下一步
paragraphs: Wireframe（線框稿）是用簡單形狀、文字與排列，表達介面內容與操作關係的草圖。低保真指暫時降低視覺細節，好讓團隊討論欄位、資訊與行為，不表示可以省略必要狀態。
本課草圖至少表達輸入、處理中、缺漏或失敗、完成四種狀態。處理中只適用真正需要等待的操作；同步檢查很快時，不為了配合草圖加入假的延遲。每種狀態要回答現在發生什麼、哪些動作可做、接著如何前進或復原。

sections.heading: 像先排演一段場景
paragraphs: 排演先確認演員從哪裡進場、看到什麼訊號、何時換場，之後再決定佈景顏色。如果所有人只在討論窗簾樣式，卻不知道發生錯誤時誰接話，正式演出仍會卡住。
線框稿也先安排工作資訊與狀態。可以用紙卡替換畫面，模擬缺件後回到輸入；不必等每個按鈕都寫好，才發現原來沒有回復方法。但排演不是程式執行，不能據此宣稱檢核規則已實作。

sections.heading: 畫面旁邊寫下觸發與限制
paragraphs: 下列卡片可作為四格草圖的文字替代。它們是不同情境，不表示每次操作必經缺件或失敗；技術失敗還需另寫回復註記，不與資料缺漏混為一談。
完成狀態要標明只通過本課三欄完整性規則。使用者修改任一欄時，舊結果應失效；這個條件寫在完成格旁，再連到 spec.md，而不是只在程式作者腦中保留。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜四格草圖要傳達的內容
blocks.description: 各卡片對應畫面狀態；轉換由檢查結果及輸入事件決定，並非固定四步。

items.title: 輸入
items.body: 三個持續可見的欄位名稱、必填與合成資料說明、檢查資料。

items.title: 處理中（條件適用）
items.body: 真有等待才顯示；保留輸入、避免重複提交，另訂逾時或失敗出口。

items.title: 缺漏／失敗
items.body: 缺漏指向欄位並提供補填方法；技術失敗另說明可採動作，不假稱缺件。

items.title: 完成
items.body: 顯示當次預覽與匯出，解釋完整性界線；修改後回到待重查。

sections.heading: 從下載包製作自己的 SVG 草圖
paragraphs: 開啟本課「工作坊資源」頁，下載 aase-v1-workshop.zip 並解壓縮。reference/wireframe.svg 是教師四狀態參考；將它複製到自己的專案並命名 wireframe.svg，保留參考原檔。用瀏覽器開啟副本可看草圖，用文字編輯器開啟則可修改文字。
先只修改 text 元素中的文字，保留 SVG 標記、座標與 viewBox，儲存後重新整理瀏覽器。若出現 XML 錯誤，回到尚未修改的副本，重做一處文字修改；不要為修圖加入腳本或外部內容。較長的註記放進 wireframe-notes.md，避免超出格子。
若暫時不能下載，可先用紙筆畫四格並依上節內容註記；正式交付仍需完成 wireframe.svg。SVG 是靜態參考圖，按鈕文字不會真的檢查資料，也不因為有四格就自動具備響應式或無障礙表單行為。

sections.heading: 依要回答的問題選保真程度
paragraphs: GOV.UK 的原型指南區分紙筆草圖與接近真實互動的程式原型，建議依當下需要選擇。草圖可以快速討論內容與操作概念；要觀察真實鍵盤、焦點、輸入保留或動態通知，需進入可操作原型。
本課不要求套用 GOV.UK 的外觀或工具包。沿 CEH 的教材版型閱讀，在工作坊自行設計收件工具；教學網站的閱讀版型與學生作品的應用程式是兩個不同對象。

sections.heading: 走讀後留下修改理由
paragraphs: 給同儕缺件卡，請他指出要看哪格、改哪欄、什麼情況能匯出。只記錄他的理解，不先替他指出下一步。再給「已檢查後修改」卡，確認草圖是否說明結果失效。單人自學可逐卡核對，但不把自查填成真人試用。
常見誤解是「黑白稿不用考慮可近用」。草圖仍應規劃標籤、錯誤文字、主要動作與合理閱讀順序，只是尚未證明程式關聯或鍵盤行為。把一項修改原因留在註記，進入 M04-05 與 M04-06 檢查資訊揭露和復原。

blocks.heading: 四格草圖的行為註記
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# wireframe.svg 行為附註（合成設計）
輸入 → 檢查：以目前三欄資料為準
處理中：只在耗時操作適用，不刻意增加延遲
缺漏 → 補填：保留已填值，指出欄位，重新檢查
技術失敗：另說明失敗與可採動作，不宣告完成
完成 → 匯出：僅表示本次完整性檢查通過
完成後修改：舊結果失效，回到待重查
取消：不產生本次報告；資料處理另依需求確認
走讀修改：填實際觀察或自查理由，不虛構真人
待驗：程式規則、鍵盤、焦點與動態通知

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器、瀏覽器及工作坊 ZIP 的 reference/wireframe.svg；只用合成文字，紙筆可先排演。
steps: 從工作坊頁下載並解壓 ZIP，複製 reference/wireframe.svg 為專案 wireframe.svg，以瀏覽器確認可開啟。
用編輯器修改一處 text 文字，重新整理確認未裁切；在 wireframe-notes.md 加上觸發、允許動作、輸入保留與回復路徑。
用缺件及修改兩張卡走讀，記錄一項修正理由；核對四格標題與靜態圖界線，保留尚待程式實測的項目。
exercise.expected: 可在瀏覽器開啟的四狀態 wireframe.svg，以及能重演缺件與修改路徑的 wireframe-notes.md。
exercise.check: 同儕或自查能指出各狀態下一步；SVG 按鈕不是實際功能，鍵盤與程式行為仍待實作驗證。
exercise.cleanup: 保留原始參考與自己的修訂版，不加入真實資料、外部圖片或腳本；紙筆替代尚未轉 SVG 時如實標記。

en.summary: Use low-fidelity four-state sketches to explain actions, conditions and feedback, revise through walkthroughs, then refine visual details.
objectives: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
Create an editable wireframe.svg and notes from the existing four-state SVG.
Explain what a static sketch can investigate and what behavior remains unproven.

readingGuide.goal: Represent screen content, primary actions and state transitions in a wireframe.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.

sections.heading: Make the Next Step Explainable
paragraphs: A wireframe uses simple shapes, text and arrangement to show interface content and interaction relationships. Low fidelity temporarily reduces visual detail to focus discussion on fields, information and behavior. It does not justify omitting necessary states.

The course sketch includes input, processing, missing information or failure, and completion. Processing applies only when an operation genuinely takes time; do not delay a fast synchronous check to match a sketch. Each state should explain what is happening, available actions and how to proceed or recover.

sections.heading: Rehearse the Scene Before Decorating It
paragraphs: Rehearsal establishes entrances, signals and scene changes before choosing scenery colors. Discussing curtains while leaving error responses unassigned can still make the performance stall.

A wireframe similarly arranges work information and states first. Paper cards can simulate returning to input after omissions before every button is coded. That rehearsal does not execute a program or establish implemented checking rules.

sections.heading: Annotate Triggers and Restrictions Beside Screens
paragraphs: These cards are textual alternatives to the four panels. They show different situations, not mandatory errors on every attempt. Technical failures need separate recovery notes rather than being confused with missing data.

Completion means only passing this course’s three-field completeness rules. Any input edit should invalidate the result. Write that condition beside the completion panel and connect it to spec.md instead of leaving it only in the programmer’s memory.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | What the Four Panels Need to Communicate
blocks.description: Each card is a screen state. Check results and input events determine transitions; these are not four fixed steps.

items.title: Input
items.body: Three persistent field names, required/synthetic-data guidance and a check action.

items.title: Processing, when applicable
items.body: Only for a real wait: retain input, prevent duplicate submission and define timeout/failure exits.

items.title: Missing information / failure
items.body: For omissions, identify fields and correction. For technical failure, explain available actions separately.

items.title: Complete
items.body: Show current preview/export and completeness limits. Edits return the task to needing a recheck.

sections.heading: Make Your SVG Copy from the Download
paragraphs: Open the workshop resources page, download aase-v1-workshop.zip and extract it. reference/wireframe.svg is the teacher’s four-state reference. Preserve it and copy it into your project as wireframe.svg. Open the copy in a browser to view it and a text editor to edit its text.

Initially change only text inside text elements, preserving SVG markup, coordinates and viewBox. Save and refresh the browser. For an XML error, return to an unmodified copy and repeat one text change. Do not add scripts or external content. Put longer annotations in wireframe-notes.md to avoid overflowing panels.

If download is temporarily unavailable, rehearse four annotated panels on paper. The final artifact still needs wireframe.svg. This static reference’s button labels do not check data. Four panels do not automatically supply responsive or accessible form behavior.

sections.heading: Choose Fidelity for the Question You Need to Answer
paragraphs: GOV.UK’s prototype guidance distinguishes paper sketches from code prototypes with closer-to-real interactions, choosing according to current needs. Sketches support quick content and action discussions; actual keyboard, focus, input retention and dynamic notifications need an operable prototype.

This course does not require GOV.UK’s visual style or toolkit. Read through the CEH-based teaching layout and design your intake application in the workshop. The learning website’s reading frame and the student’s application are different objects.

sections.heading: Record Reasons for Changes After a Walkthrough
paragraphs: Give a peer a missing-input card and ask which panel applies, which field to change and when export is possible. Record understanding without first pointing out the next action. Follow with the edit-after-check card to examine result invalidation. Independent learners may check cards themselves without recording self-review as participant testing.

A common mistake is ignoring accessibility in a monochrome sketch. Plan labels, error text, primary actions and sensible reading order while retaining programmatic relationships and keyboard behavior as unproven. Record one change reason before M04-05 and M04-06 examine disclosure and recovery.

blocks.heading: Behavior Notes for Four Panels
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template records current-input checking, conditional processing, missing-input recovery, separate technical failure, limited completion/export, edit invalidation, cancellation, actual walkthrough/self-review reasons and pending program/keyboard/focus/notification tests. Adapt it for class; it is not actual rules or findings.
blocks.code:
# wireframe.svg 行為附註（合成設計）
輸入 → 檢查：以目前三欄資料為準
處理中：只在耗時操作適用，不刻意增加延遲
缺漏 → 補填：保留已填值，指出欄位，重新檢查
技術失敗：另說明失敗與可採動作，不宣告完成
完成 → 匯出：僅表示本次完整性檢查通過
完成後修改：舊結果失效，回到待重查
取消：不產生本次報告；資料處理另依需求確認
走讀修改：填實際觀察或自查理由，不虛構真人
待驗：程式規則、鍵盤、焦點與動態通知

exercise.environment: A text editor, browser and reference/wireframe.svg from the workshop ZIP. Use synthetic text only; paper can support initial rehearsal.
steps: Download and extract the workshop ZIP, copy reference/wireframe.svg to your project as wireframe.svg and confirm it opens in a browser.
Edit one text element, refresh and check for clipping. Add triggers, allowed actions, input retention and recovery to wireframe-notes.md.
Walk through missing-input and edit cards and record one change reason. Check four-panel titles and static-image limits, retaining pending program tests.
exercise.expected: A browser-readable four-state wireframe.svg and wireframe-notes.md that supports replaying missing-input and edit paths.
exercise.check: A peer or self-review can identify the next action for each state. SVG buttons are not working features; keyboard and program behavior remain to be verified.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the original reference and your revision. Add no real data, external images or scripts. Label a paper substitute honestly until converted to SVG.

zh.prompt: 低保真草圖最應先確認什麼？
options: 品牌色是否流行
所有動畫是否完成
介面內容、動作、狀態與回復路徑是否可理解
伺服器效能已達標
rationales: 配色可後續細化，不能取代行為。
本章不需先完成動畫。
這是草圖能協助討論的核心工作。
靜態草圖不測伺服器效能。

en.prompt: What should a low-fidelity sketch establish first?
options: Whether brand colors are fashionable.
Whether all animations are complete.
Whether content, actions, states and recovery paths are understandable.
Whether server performance meets targets.
rationales: Color refinement cannot replace behavior design.
Animation need not be completed first.
These are core questions a sketch can support.
A static sketch does not test server performance.

zh.prompt: 四格中有處理中狀態，實作應如何處理？
options: 只有真有等待才顯示，並設計失敗或逾時出口
每次強制延遲以便看動畫
收到輸入就先顯示完成
處理中可遺失已填資料
rationales: 狀態回饋應對應真實行為。
假的延遲會增加無必要等待。
未取得結果不應宣告完成。
需設計進度保留與復原。

en.prompt: The sketch has a processing panel. How should implementation handle it?
options: Show it only for an actual wait, defining failure or timeout exits.
Always delay execution to show animation.
Show completion as soon as input arrives.
Lose entered data during processing.
rationales: State feedback should match actual behavior.
Artificial delay creates unnecessary waiting.
Do not declare completion before results exist.
Plan progress retention and recovery.

zh.prompt: 同儕看懂 SVG 並指出匯出位置，能證明什麼？
options: 應用程式支援所有鍵盤操作
所有檢核規則已通過測試
正式上線安全已驗證
本次草圖中的理解線索可被指出，程式與實際操作仍待驗
rationales: SVG 沒有真實表單的鍵盤路徑。
沒有執行檢核程式。
草圖不驗證上線安全。
結論限於靜態草圖走讀範圍。

en.prompt: A peer understands the SVG and locates export. What does this establish?
options: The application supports every keyboard action.
Every checking rule passed tests.
Production security is verified.
The peer identified understanding cues in this sketch; code and actual operation remain to be verified.
rationales: An SVG has no real form keyboard path.
No checking program was executed.
A sketch does not verify deployment security.
The conclusion stays within the static walkthrough’s scope.
